No field-data inversions yet. Each run goes in its own folder in `results/field/runs/`, set up the same way as a checkerboard run (see [How to add results](../../adding-results.qmd)). The run shows up here with the same depth slider and comparison tools.

::: {data-akviewer="" data-src="runs.json" data-mode="run"}
:::

## Slab comparison

Compare the slab recovered by the inversion with independent estimates of its geometry:

- **Slab2** depth contours for the Alaska–Aleutians region [@hayes2018; @hayes2018data]
- Published Alaska models [@berg2020; @martinshort2016; @nayak2020] and the other papers under *Validating inversion results* on the [Literature](../../literature/index.qmd) page
- The Wadati–Benioff zone traced by our own catalog seismicity

*To be added once the first field-data inversion is run.*
